newsitem.title: USA: Banctec says '96 revenues/EPS meet estimates.
newsitem.headline: Banctec says '96 revenues/EPS meet estimates.

text.p: BancTec Inc said Tuesday that, based on preliminary, unaudited results, it expects to report 1996 revenues in excess of $552 million and earnings per share of about $1.75, in line with analysts' expectations.
It said it expects to report its final fourth quarter and year-end audited results during the third week of this month.

"I am pleased to report that we met the financial and operating targets we set in the transition year following BancTec's acquisition of Recognition International," said chairman and chief executive officer Grahame Clark Jr.
Clark said the company is optimistic it can continue its strong performance through 1997.
